title: Treatise on Linked Cuts
summary: Teaches a student of the sabre to chain two and three cuts on one flow of qi and to break a foe's chain in turn.

title: Second Primer of the Sabre Arm
summary: A second primer that trains arm and wrist for the point drive and the arm hook once the basic cuts are sound.

title: Treatise on the Hung Blade Guard
summary: Develops the guard that hangs the blade point-down before the body and the counters and covers that spring from it.

title: Handbook of Sabre Pursuit
summary: Teaches how to chase and corner a retreating foe with a running slash while keeping the sabre arm balanced.

title: Method of the Rolling Cut
summary: Turns the blade through continuous wheels of qi-fed cuts so that every parry and every cut is one turning motion.

title: Discourse on Edge Against Edge
summary: Discusses how to meet an enemy blade edge to edge and bind or shatter it without losing one's own line.

title: The Wrapping Blade Course
summary: A course in wrapping the sabre round the head and shoulders to guard and then cut back from the wrap.

title: Course of the Overhead Circle
summary: Draws the blade in great circles above the head to cover the body and then drops the circle into a heavy hew.

title: Treatise on Reversed Grip Work
summary: Teaches the sabre held edge-out along the forearm for short hidden cuts and hooks and thrusts at close range.

title: Handbook of the Seasoned Edge
summary: Gathers the patient habits of old sabre hands into a short course that breaks a guard and ends it with one heavy hew.
